title: PackageVersionOrigin
description: Information about how a package version was added to a repository.

allOf.description: A DomainEntryPoint object that contains information about from which repository or external connection the package version was added to the domain.

Describes how the package version was originally added to the domain. An INTERNAL origin type means the package version was published directly to a repository in the domain. An EXTERNAL origin type means the package version was ingested from an external connection.
